profiles.notes: NSC school-leaving requirements use South Africa’s National Senior Certificate. The Admission Point Score (APS) uses the university’s South African scoring scale. Programme codes distinguish direct and extended entry.

requirements.label: How Venda calculates the NSC Admission Point Score
requirements.details: Exclude Life Orientation and subjects below 40%. Where the results list more than seven subjects, Venda uses the seven highest eligible marks. Meeting the entry thresholds does not guarantee a place.

source.title: University of Venda · 2027 undergraduate prospectus

requirements.label: Documents for applicants currently in Grade 12
requirements.details: Upload PDF copies of your identity document or passport and your school-stamped final Grade 11 results (term four).

source.title: University of Venda · 2027 undergraduate prospectus

requirements.label: Documents for applicants with tertiary study
requirements.details: Applicants who are studying or have studied at another higher education institution supply their academic record. Previous tertiary study also requires a certificate of good conduct.

source.title: University of Venda · 2027 undergraduate prospectus

requirements.label: Minimum NSC Admission Point Score of 26
requirements.details: The minimum APS for this NSC entry route is 26. The applicable subject grades and pass endorsement are separate entry conditions.

source.title: University of Venda · 2027 undergraduate prospectus

requirements.label: Minimum NSC Admission Point Score of 24
requirements.details: The published NSC route specifies an APS of at least 24. The required pass endorsement and subjects depend on the programme.

source.title: University of Venda · 2027 undergraduate prospectus

requirements.label: Minimum NSC Admission Point Score of 35
requirements.details: Applicants following the NSC route need an APS of at least 35 and must also meet the named subject conditions.

source.title: University of Venda · 2027 undergraduate prospectus

requirements.label: NSC bachelor’s pass
requirements.details: Present an NSC with a bachelor’s pass for degree entry.

source.title: University of Venda · 2027 undergraduate prospectus

requirements.label: Standard BSc subject grades
requirements.details: The science stream lists NSC level 4 (50% or above) in each of English, Mathematics, Physical Sciences and Life Sciences. These are four recognised 20-credit school subjects.

source.title: University of Venda · 2027 undergraduate prospectus

requirements.label: Science faculty alternatives and selection
requirements.details: A related subject may be accepted following assessment by the responsible department head and approval by the executive dean. The faculty may consider equivalent FET Level 4 qualifications in the named subjects and may apply its selection procedure.

source.title: University of Venda · 2027 undergraduate prospectus

requirements.label: Extended BSc subject grades
requirements.details: Obtain NSC level 3 (at least 40%) in English, Mathematics, Physical Sciences and one additional relevant subject accepted by the responsible department.

source.title: University of Venda · 2027 undergraduate prospectus

requirements.label: Confirm the pass endorsement and subjects for this extended BSc
requirements.details: The course catalogue calls for a bachelor’s pass and NSC level 3 or above in English, Mathematics, Physical Sciences and a faculty-approved subject. The 2027 prospectus instead specifies diploma admission, English at 30%, four recognised 20-credit subjects at level 3 and at least 50% in Life Sciences, Agricultural Sciences, Physical Sciences or Geography. Both sources give APS 24. Confirm the applicable subject route with the faculty.

source.title: University of Venda · 2027 undergraduate prospectus

requirements.label: Agriculture subject grades
requirements.details: For NSC entry, English, Mathematics and Physical Sciences must each reach level 4 (at least 50%). A fourth science subject is also required.

source.title: University of Venda · 2027 undergraduate prospectus

requirements.label: Fourth science for Agricultural Economics
requirements.details: Meet level 4 (50% or above) in either Agricultural Sciences or Life Sciences. Both the programme catalogue and the prospectus list this choice.

source.title: University of Venda · 2027 undergraduate prospectus

requirements.label: Fourth science subject in the two university sources
requirements.details: Life Sciences at level 4 (50% or above) is accepted by both sources. The individual programme page also accepts Agricultural Sciences at that level, while the programme row in the 2027 prospectus names only Life Sciences. Applicants using Agricultural Sciences should confirm acceptance with the faculty.

source.title: University of Venda · 2027 undergraduate prospectus

requirements.label: Food Science and Technology thresholds differ between university sources
requirements.details: The course page specifies APS 32, level 5 for Mathematics and Physical Sciences, and level 4 for English and either Life Sciences or Agricultural Sciences. The 2027 prospectus gives APS 26 and level 4 for all four subject areas. Confirm the applicable threshold with the faculty before relying on either figure.

source.title: University of Venda · 2027 undergraduate prospectus

requirements.label: Freshwater Technology diploma admission
requirements.details: Hold an NSC with diploma admission. The diploma requires at least 30% in English, level 3 (40% or above) in four recognised 20-credit subjects, and at least 50% in one of Geography, Physical Sciences, Agricultural Sciences or Life Sciences.

source.title: University of Venda · Diploma in Freshwater Technology · 2027 entry

requirements.label: Hydrology and Water Resources school subjects
requirements.details: English, Mathematics and Physical Sciences each require level 5 (at least 60%). Achieve level 4 (at least 50%) in at least three of Geography, Economics, Life Sciences, Accounting and Agricultural Sciences.

source.title: University of Venda · 2027 undergraduate prospectus

requirements.label: Disaster Risk Reduction school subjects
requirements.details: Geography, Mathematics and Life Sciences each require level 5 (at least 60%). English, Physical Sciences and Economics each require at least level 4 (50%).

source.title: University of Venda · 2027 undergraduate prospectus

requirements.label: Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering NSC entry
requirements.details: The course page gives a minimum APS of 32. Meet NSC level 6 in Mathematics, Physical Sciences and one of Agricultural Sciences or Life Sciences. English requires level 4.

source.title: University of Venda · Bachelor of Science in Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering · 2027 entry

requirements.label: Documents for international applicants
requirements.details: The prospectus lists a copy of the study and residence permit, medical insurance and a South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation certificate. Provide the passport or ID number, or the student reference requested on the form.
